purpose: Standardize the compact reasoning and safeguard payload required when a task intentionally deletes or suppresses an existing compensating function, fallback path, or rollback-only branch.
applies_to: code_change_required tasks that remove an existing helper, compensating function, retry guard, compatibility fallback, or rollback-only path

required_fields.description: Function, method, file path, or guarded branch being removed.
Short statement of why the system no longer requires the compensating path.
Canonical authority that now owns the behavior being preserved.
What user-visible or system-level failure would occur if the deletion is incorrect.
Focused validation command, test, or runtime proof that demonstrates parity after deletion.

optional_fields.description: Short note when deletion is part of a staged migration and the prior path is intentionally being retired.
Condition that would justify reintroducing or replacing the removed path.

authoring_rules: Keep the payload compact and execution-friendly.
Do not repeat broad background already captured in ticket_contract_current.
Describe the replacement authority concretely, using a contract, service, or canonical lane reference when possible.
Use this gate only for real removal/suppression decisions, not for routine edits.
verifier_expectations: Verifier must be able to identify what was removed.
Verifier must be able to trace the replacement authority.
Verifier must see a focused proof that the removal preserved behavior or intentionally retired obsolete behavior.
Missing or vague gate content should be treated as insufficient evidence for destructive deletion.

root_cause_gate_current.why_safe_now: YAML-only routing is now authoritative and this fallback can no longer select live models.
root_cause_gate_current.failure_if_wrong: Planner or gateway could silently route via a retired fallback path.
root_cause_gate_current.migration_note: Final cleanup after YAML-only routing rollout.
